name: Nevatech Sentinet
description_en:
Nevatech Sentinet is a product in the API management category. Its directory profile covers Analytics, Traffic Control, Threat Protection, Developer Portal, API Lifecycle Management, API Design, Dashboard, Version Control.

Additional listed capabilities include Testing Management, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: define interface structure and request-response contracts; bring selected indicators and records into one view; track changes to files and support revision workflows; organize test cases, execution and results; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出测试管理、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：定义接口结构和请求响应约定；在同一视图中汇集选定指标和记录；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程；组织测试用例、执行过程与结果；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Official Sentinet 6.7 overview and requirements were read: .NET/IIS gateway nodes, SQL Server/Azure SQL repository, optional Umbraco developer portal, and virtual-service facades. The official download flow requires a company email. No readable official pricing/fee schedule or commercial license grant was found; a guessed purchase path was inaccessible, and LicenseInfo describes technical license types rather than an actual purchase entitlement. Current completion rules require an actual official pricing source, so this record stays incomplete; no source is relabeled as pricing merely to pass validation.
research_gaps.zh: 已读官方 Sentinet 6.7 架构及要求：.NET／IIS 网关节点、SQL Server／Azure SQL 仓库、可选 Umbraco 开发者门户及虚拟服务门面。官方下载要求公司邮箱。未找到可读官方计价／费用表及商业授权条款；尝试的购买路径不可访问，LicenseInfo 只描述技术许可类型，不是实际采购权限。完成规则要求真实官方定价来源，因此保持未完成，不将其他来源改标为定价以通过校验。
